title: Courier Operations Standard for Delivery & Pickup Services: Signatures, ID Checks, Door Drops and Late Deliveries
content:
This standard governs how a Delivery & Pickup Services order is handed over and when a delivery counts as late.

## Standard

1. **Signature.** An order needs a signature on handover where the plan requires a signature on every order, where its order value is at or above the plan's signature value threshold and that threshold is above $0.00, or where it carries a prescription whose class requires a delivery signature under the Prescriptions charter.
2. **Controlled substances.** An order carrying a controlled substance is handed only to an adult who shows photo ID where the plan checks ID on controlled deliveries, and the handover is recorded as an ID-checked signature.
3. **Door drop.** An order that needs no signature may be left at the door where the plan allows door drops, and the handover is recorded as a contactless drop.
4. **One delivery.** An order is delivered at most once: an order already recorded as delivered, cancelled or returned to the store is not recorded as delivered again.
5. **Late.** A delivery is late when the delivered time is more than the plan's late threshold minutes after the promised window end on the scheduled date, or when it arrives on a later date.

## When a signature is needed

| Plan requires a signature on every order | Order value at or above a threshold above $0.00 | Prescription class requires a delivery signature | Signature needed |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | any | any | yes |
| no | yes | any | yes |
| no | no | yes | yes |
| no | no | no | no |

## Lateness worked through (hypothetical, 30-minute late threshold)

| Promised window end | Delivered | Late? |
|---|---|---|
| 15:00 on the scheduled date | 15:20 on the scheduled date | no |
| 15:00 on the scheduled date | 15:30 on the scheduled date | no (exactly 30 minutes) |
| 15:00 on the scheduled date | 15:31 on the scheduled date | yes |
| 15:00 on the scheduled date | 09:10 the next day | yes (a later date) |

With the 60-minute threshold of Kestrel Specialty Courier Service, a delivery at 16:00 against a 15:00 window end is not late and one at 16:01 is.
